seller_feedback.feedback_text: Fast shipping. Item as described. Good packaging. Arrived in good condition. Recommended seller! Thanks!
Item appears to be as described. Received on time, but as the seller refused to sent it to my Post Office box, the package sat in my rarely-used home mailbox for an unknown length of time.

After ~a day since I've placed an order, seller contact me and said that they ran out of the cards and sent them in order of orders being placed (I bought several cards when they had  10 sold, out of 49 they put as available to order).
